Package Manager: Android app (not a traditional package manager)
Method of Attack: Installed via compromised vendor update server in a supply-chain attack
Repeatedly opening web browsers and displaying advertisements
Reinstallation by update app running as system process
Impacted Systems: Older smartphone models of GS100, GS160, GS170, GS180, GS270 (plus), GS370 (plus) series
Attack Vector: Compromised update server used by Gigaset devices
System update app installing malicious apps
Indicators of Compromise: Unknown app 'easenf' running and reinstalling automatically
